column3: HR Diemen's 2011 equivalence catalogue maps LG 6174Z-1017D to HR 46455 (no data held) and 6174Z-1017H to HR 46177 (schematic, 30.6 kV, B+ pin 2, COL pin 1; fitted to Apple CRT iMacs, M5521). The -D is reported as an iMac G3 part, which is why the -H is the sibling chosen. The suffix letter alone proves little: the 6174Z-1017 range covers at least eight HR codes, and of the three with data, -A (HR 46187) matches the -H closely but -E (HR 46255) has a different pin-out and 25.5 kV. Treat the HR 46177 sheet as a lead and check pin-out and anode rating on the part.

Both are Orega 40308 parts (-17 and -42) supplied to B&O, as 8014123 and 8014136. The HR sheets show the same pin-out (B+ 11, collector 3, EHT return 9, grounds 4, 5 and 2) and the same three windings (1-2; 12-4-10; 7-6-5), with taps within about 25%: 40/20/60/180/90 Vpp against 50/20/50/165/85. Check two things. HR 6680's sheet shows no pin 8 tap (110 Vpp negative on HR 6469), so find out whether the set uses it. HR 6680's recorded 46.5 kV anode figure is implausible for a direct-view TV, so check the EHT rather than trusting it. HR 6680 was also sold for Thomson sets (Dönberg lists it as 4030842 / 10165660).
